CROSS-BORDER EXECUTION | G4-G6 | Product lifecycle and partnership
|
|-- Scale: cross-border is distinct from merchant geography
|   |-- [S] 2022: ~$28B sales; ~28% of traffic came from abroad.
|   |-- [S] GMV share: ~15% Q3 2023; 15% Q3 2025; 16% Q1 2026.
|   `-- [I] Traffic share versus GMV share cannot isolate conversion.
|
|-- Markets -> Markets Pro -> Managed Markets: product evolution
|   |-- [S] Q3 2022: Pro early access; built on Markets.
|   |-- [S] Markets offers selectable tools; Pro adds merchant of record.
|   |-- [R] Pro manages tax and duty compliance.
|   |-- [S] Q1 2023 plan: UK later that year.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2023: US general availability; beyond-US plan for 2024.
|   |-- [S] Q4 2025 call: Managed Markets 2.0 integrated into Payments.
|   `-- [S] Q2 2026: first expansion beyond US, to Canada and UK.
|       Actual timing -[contra]-> [X] earlier launch schedule fulfilled.
|
|-- Adoption evidence -[assoc]-> broader selling footprint
|   |-- [S] Q1 2023: ~100,000 merchants used Markets/Pro cross-border.
|   |-- [S] EY sample, 2024: 83% sold into more countries after adoption.
|   |-- [S] That subset averaged >40% international sales growth.
|   `-- [I] Excerpt supplies no control group or sample selection method.
|
`-- Global-E: partner economics and unresolved overlap
    |-- [R] April 2021: equity received as non-cash revenue consideration.
    |-- [R] FY25 equity value: $868M (seed units; filing row shows 868).
    |-- Shopify -[mech]-> ownership of a Global-E investment.
    |-- [S] Q1 2026: Global-e named among integrated payment partners.
    |-- [I] Equity ownership does not establish corporate control.
    `-- Native vs partner volumes -[untestable]-> competitive attribution.
        [I] Product overlap suggests possible tension, not proven conflict.
